notes: Accepted after a bounded R3 review of the frozen rules, calibration, review policy and all 1,136 active entity candidates. All 12 reviewed bindings matched the R3 freeze, every candidate-shard binding verified, and aggregate counts were 56,479 total: topic 23,469, concept 31,874 and entity 1,136; support was title-only 38,474, notes-only 5,003, multi-field 13,002 and metadata-only 0. The entity sweep found no unregistered target, duplicate identifier, unmatched evidence literal or surviving unsafe qualified-name collision. E020 exclusively carries all 19 European Environment Agency candidates to its official EEA target; E004 carries none. E002 excludes Imperial Bank of England, E005 excludes every Pensions Regulator Tribunal context, E011 excludes Montserrat's commission while retaining the UK founding Act, E001 remains retired, and E017/E018/E019 have 1/11/12 jurisdiction-specific candidates. Residual immediate prefix and compound contexts were inspected and referred to the same registered body or a non-entity modifier. A separate independent Codex full-population reconstruction reported zero candidate or terminal mismatches across 365,786 works; this bounded R3 task did not rerun it and made no source edits.
